entities.summary: Nouri Bouzid is a Tunisian film director and screenwriter, widely regarded as Tunisia's most prominent filmmaker and a pioneering figure in Maghreb cinema. Known for his unflinching exploration of taboo subjects in Arab society—including child sexual abuse, male prostitution, political repression, and religious extremism—Bouzid has directed nine feature films between 1986 and 2019.
